I purchased a Keurig 250 2.0 coffee maker, along with a variety pack of K-cups, some Keurig brand and some not, but was dismayed to discover the 2.0 would only accept Keurig brand K-cups, so I started searching for solutions. First I ordered a reusable stainless steel K-cup, and thought I would just pour the contents of non-Keurig K-cups into it and brew that way, but then I came across this nifty item. The SoloClip 2 was easy to clip onto my Keurig and works perfectly. So now, with my reusable K-cup I can brew standard packaged coffee, and with the SoloClip 2 I can brew any brand of K-cup.
It fits my Keurig K475 perfectly and so far works with everything I've tried. I expect it's metal construction will last a long time, maybe even the life of the coffee maker.

But I do drink decaf coffee and the variety that I can purchase really expands if I'm not limited to official k-cups.  I was glad not to have to go clipping wires in my new Keurig or taping old lids in weird places to use my existing coffee supplies or be limited in the future with my new machine. I bought this clip when I bought my new Keurig brewer, anticipating that I'd eventually come across a K-cup that didn't work. That finally happened today, when I found out the K-cups I purchased from Amazon were not compatible with 2.0 brewers as Amazon's description claimed. I put the clip on, and it just worked.

The instructions were a bit difficult to understand due to the poor quality of the image, but the clip really is easy to install and feels like it will stay in place. I don't know of any reason why I shouldn't just leave it there, so hopefully it won't loosen up. But even if it does, I think I can carefully bend it back.

I remedied that by using a highlighter on a piece of paper which I then placed over the "orange" spot on this device and it worked perfectly following that.

If you are wanting to get around the constraints of only using the official K-cups, this device fits and works perfectly. Being made of metal, I expect it to last a long time. If you want to also add the extended menus, you'll have to find another solution or simply take care of the matter by using your own highlighter with this device.

One of my best purchases. I bought a 2.0 machine not realizing that Keurig had the new sensor that would only allow the use of authorized k-cups. I had found out after a bought a large box of refills from my local wholesale supply club. After doing some research I found a way to use a used authorized cup and cut the top off and trick the machine into thinking the pod was authorized. Needless to say this was a very tedious task to go thru to just get a cup of coffee.

We purchased this clip after doing research on cheaper products that would come in a multi pac, I was like why are they in a multi pack unless they are not going to last and have to be replaced. So we decided against the plastic ones. Then we looked at the stickers that are also sold, sure they are reusable but again extra work every time you want a cup of coffee.

this came and it was installed in a matter of seconds. Popped in a generic pop and it worked flawlessly. No we also use the keurig to make tea and we were only able to dispense a small cup of hot water so we would have to run two cycles to get our bigger mugs filled but with this the menu thinks there is a k-cup in and we have the option to select a bigger size so it actually makes life a lot easier for us.

I would highly recommend this to anyone that is tired of having to make sure that your k-cups are authorized or like to use a refillable pop
